name: math-skill-path
description: Skills path + competency (v1.1, operator UAT 2026-09-25). Addition to 10 has 24 solid facts and one (4 + 5) at 1-in-a-row, so it sits Up next at 2 stars. A Race of it brings 4 + 5 back, it turns solid IN the run, and the level-up names the skill with the level haptic. Back closes only the level-up; results show the star gain; home is redrawn the moment results close; a later skill can be focused (all open); Go again repeats a skill practice; the badge shelf shows the badge. steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}var n=0,sawTarget=false;while(!document.getElementById('runLayer').hidden&&n<30){if(/^(4 \+ 5|5 \+ 4)$/.test(document.getElementById('problem').textContent))sawTarget=true;type(ans());n++;await sleep(330);}return n===10&&sawTarget;})()
